title: Người ở lại
about: Round 25, ke-chuyen ("bạn hãy tự sáng tác những bản khác hay hơn, phối theo kiểu bạn đề xuất"): A minor at 63 bpm over the lament bass (A-G-F-E). Its motif is a sigh falling a fourth, E-D-C-B to A, answered by a line rising to F; the sigh is then sung a step higher over Dm, and in the middle section it turns into a climb to D6 over F-G-Em-Am, Esus4 resolving to E. The arc: the piano alone; the cellos join with a slow second line; the climax with the strings holding the chords and the piano rolling them; the piano alone again, the violas only at the sentences' ends; the sigh once more to close, unfinished. An original tune.
